text:
SRE Bot: INC [sev2] pagerflow-automation: paging suppressed for recent alerts, no pages sent in last 12m.
Alex: seeing ~50 webhook attempts dropped for prod customers, oncall didn't get paged. :eyes:
Maya: I'm oncall and didn't receive a page — only the slack alert. did incidentbot try and fail?
Alex: initial look — incidentbot responses show gateway rejects: missing X-Pager-TTL header -> `reject`.
Luis: jumping in, tailing gateway logs now.
Luis: gateway snippet -> `2026-03-18T12:05:41Z ERROR webhook id=ab12 reason=ttl_header_missing src=10.12.4.8`
Luis: also saw rate-limiter flip: `rl_allowed=false` for a burst from 172.31.0.9, some retries returned 429.
Alex: can we do manual escalation for the affected customers? don't want automation gap while we triage.
Maya: starting manual ringdown: paging prod-sre, eng-oncall, eng-ml. calling phone group now.
Priya: enabling console fallback -> toggled `sms_fallback=true` for pagerflow routing (temporary).
SRE Bot: ACTION created INC-2026-234 and attached runbook <https://runbooks/redwood/pagerflow-fallback>.
Luis: quick mitigation: rolling restart of pager-ingress to refresh header parsing, starting now.
Alex: after restart: `INFO webhook: accepted id=ab13` but still 5 rejects showing `signature_mismatch`.
Luis: note — signing key rotated ~2h ago; proxy cache may still have old key. pushing rotation to caches.
Jamie: applying key to proxy cache: `kubectl -n infra exec cache-redis -- redis-cli HSET signing_keys current new-kid-2026`
Maya: phone escalation confirmed, oncall acknowledged; CS notified customers via status update.
Alex: customer impact: two tenants saw delayed pages (9min window), SLA hit on paging latency, no message loss reported.
Priya: draft status update: "Paging delays for subset of customers due to webhook header parsing + proxy cache mismatch; manual escalations active; mitigation in progress." Approve?
Maya: lgtm, post it.
Luis: restart finished, accept rate normalizing, signatures accepted after cache push.
Alex: root-cause suspects: strict header validation + stale signing key in proxy cache + a burst triggering rate limiter.
Priya: actions: 1) add TTL header fallback logic (treat missing TTL as non-fatal) 2) make signing key rollout idempotent across cache layers 3) incidentbot: retry on transient 5xx from gateway.
Maya: runbook updates: add explicit step to toggle `sms_fallback` and manual ringdown checklist.
SRE Bot: RESOLVE: paging automation restored at 12:18Z. postmortem and action items created.
Alex: thanks all. scheduling customer follow-up at 15:30 PT with CS.
Maya: I'll own the retro and will add the runbook tweaks. closing thread after notes added. :white_check_mark:
